name: Ten Commandments
overview: The Ten Commandments, as revealed by God in Exodus 20, establish foundational moral and spiritual principles for His people, beginning with the exclusive worship of Him alone and the reverent use of His name. These commandments, reaffirmed in Exodus 34 after Moses' prolonged encounter with the LORD, include prohibitions against killing and adultery, underscoring God's holy standard for righteous living. Together, they form a covenantal guide that calls believers to live in obedience to God's righteous will.
